train_model: run the pycls training loop to train a classification model with FSDP and mixed precision support
test_model: evaluate a trained pycls classification model on a test dataset and log accuracy metrics
setup_model: build and configure a pycls model with optional FSDP wrapping and EMA model for distributed training
auto_wrap_ln: wrap all LayerNorm layers in a PyTorch module with FSDP for safer mixed precision training
time_model_and_loader: benchmark the pycls model forward pass and data loader throughput for performance profiling
